description.zh:
⼈物库ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性（请妥善保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用）。
><notice>不能与系统⼈物库ID相同，如果相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。></notice>
description.en:
The unique ID for a custom figure library. The caller generates this ID and must ensure it is unique. Save this ID to use when you call other APIs.
><notice>This ID cannot be the same as a system figure library ID. If the IDs match, the system figure library is used by default. The ID can be up to 120 characters long, is case-insensitive, and supports characters from any language.></notice>

description.zh: 需要注册的⼈脸图⽚公网地址，图⽚中有且仅包含⼀张正脸。
description.en: The public URL of the image containing the face to register. The image must contain exactly one frontal face.

description.zh:
⼈物ID，⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物。由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性（请妥善保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用） 。
> 最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写，返回FaceId为String类型。
description.en:
The ID of the custom person. This ID uniquely identifies a custom person. You generate this ID and ensure its uniqueness. Store it securely for use with other API calls.

> Supports up to 120 characters, supports Chinese and English characters, is case-insensitive, and returns FaceId as a String.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口一次仅能注册一张自定义人脸。
- 一个自定义人脸最多注册10张图像。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342832~~)。
descriptions.en:
- You can register one custom face per API call.

- You can register up to 10 images for a single custom face.

## QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this API appropriately. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342832~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts register-custom-face --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --image-url http://example-0000.jpeg --person-name example-string --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
